# Extract the time strings for Valentino Rossi and Ralf Waldmann
rossi_time = df.loc[df['Rider'] == 'Valentino Rossi', 'Time/Retired'].iloc[0]
waldmann_time = df.loc[df['Rider'] == 'Ralf Waldmann', 'Time/Retired'].iloc[0]

# Both times are given as offsets from the winner's time (e.g., "+0.180", "+7.019")
# Remove the '+' sign and convert to seconds (they are already in seconds except for the colon in some rows, but these two are simple)
rossi_seconds = float(rossi_time.lstrip('+'))
waldmann_seconds = float(waldmann_time.lstrip('+'))

# Compute the difference
time_difference = waldmann_seconds - rossi_seconds
answer = time_difference
